    Critical pieces without a support condition #

    The Kronecker pair of a critical piece need not be supported at every vertex of the piece: covering data are obtained after restricting the pair to its support (PairCoveringData.ofPair). CriticalPieceCarriesPair and CoverDichotomy have no support condition.
